    # nhe is NULL (0)
    s.add(nhe == 0)

    s.add(err == -2)
    
    # After cleanup loop (i--; i >= 0; --i), i becomes -1

    # Model the post-loop state: i == -1
    i_after = Int('i_after')

    # Check satisfiability
